Domestic trade is within one country; foreign trade crosses borders and involves imports and exports.
Visible: trade in goods. Invisible: trade in services such as tourism, transport and banking.
A tariff is a tax on imports; a quota is a limit on the quantity imported.
A group of countries that reduce or remove trade barriers between themselves.
SADC: Gaborone. COMESA: Lusaka. ECOWAS: Abuja. OPEC: Vienna.
